description: This file manages contract surface modules for plugins, including discovery, loading, and caching of plugin surfaces, with functions to resolve module paths and handle environment configurations.

methods.name: createModuleLoader
methods.description: Creates a loader function that caches and loads modules using Jiti with alias mapping.

methods.name: getContractSurfaceDiscoveryEnv
methods.description: Returns environment variables for contract surface discovery, adjusting for built artifacts.

methods.name: matchesPreferredBasename
methods.description: Checks if a basename matches a preferred basename, ignoring file extensions.

methods.name: resolveDistPreferredModulePath
methods.description: Resolves the module path to a distribution build if available.

methods.name: resolveContractSurfaceModulePaths
methods.description: Resolves module paths for contract surface files in a given root directory.

methods.name: resolveSourceFirstContractSurfaceModulePaths
methods.description: Resolves source or built module paths prioritizing source files if available.

methods.name: loadBundledChannelContractSurfaces
methods.description: Loads all bundled channel contract surfaces.

methods.name: loadBundledChannelContractSurfaceEntries
methods.description: Loads entries of bundled channel contract surfaces with plugin IDs.

methods.name: getBundledChannelContractSurfaces
methods.description: Returns cached bundled channel contract surfaces.

methods.name: getBundledChannelContractSurfaceEntries
methods.description: Returns cached entries of bundled channel contract surfaces.

methods.name: getBundledChannelContractSurfaceModule
methods.description: Retrieves a specific plugin's contract surface module, with caching.
